BiblicalUsage: En-hak-Kore is a place near Palestine. The name appears in Judges (Judges 15:19). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-hak-Kore matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-hak-Kore is one of them.
